errors.text_span: wobei die Beschriftung jedes Jahr angezeigt wird
errors.evidence: The x-axis labels are shown for every two years (1987, 1989, 1991, etc.), not for every year as stated.
The TSEB line is blue in the chart, not green. The green line represents TSEC.

errors.text_span: steigt bis etwa 400 Euro pro Hektar um 1995 und bleibt danach relativ stabil bei etwa 400 bis 450 Euro pro Hektar bis 2017
errors.evidence: This description of the TSEB line is an oversimplification. After 1995, the line continues to rise to a peak of approximately 560 Euro in 2003 before decreasing and then stabilizing in the 400-450 Euro range. The description omits this significant peak.
While the TSEC line is indeed green, the use of "ebenfalls" (also) is incorrect and confusing because it follows the erroneous statement that the TSEB line is green. The TSEB line is blue.

errors.text_span: steigt dann leicht auf etwa 100 bis 150 Euro pro Hektar bis 2017
errors.evidence: After 2011, the TSEC line rises from a low of about 50 Euro, but it never reaches 150 Euro. It peaks around 120 Euro in 2013 and ends at about 100 Euro in 2017. The range 100-150 is an overestimation.
